description: Composite market-conditions risk score (0-100) for a major crypto asset, combining trend position, realised volatility, drawdown, cross-exchange funding crowding, sentiment extremity and stablecoin peg stress, with a full factor breakdown and confidence figure. Use as a pre-action check before trading or allocating. Scores market conditions, not token contract safety. Informational only, not financial advice. Paid: $0.015 via x402.

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL (default BTC)
